Aid for Doctoral Students
Because our PhD candidates complete extensive individualized research, we want you to complete your degree with the fewest possible interruptions, thus allowing you to move on to industry or academia expeditiously.
Most of our doctoral students enroll full-time and receive competitive funding packages. Funding includes a competitive fellowship, a full-tuition scholarship, and health insurance benefits. Details of funding will be provided at the time of admission. Both international and U.S. students are considered for departmental fellowships. All awards are contingent on the conditions set out annually in the University Bulletin, including (but not limited to) satisfactory academic progress and changes in student status.
Stipend Information
Form I-9
I-9s are to be completed online through Workday. If you will be receiving a fellowship or assistantship, you will receive a task list from Workday prompting you to complete your I-9.
You must complete your I-9 by your payroll start date (usually late August for new students starting in the fall semester); however, we encourage students to complete their I-9s as soon as possible to avoid delays in payment.
Section 1: Must be completed online by you in Workday.
Section 2: Once you submit Section 1, a member of the Office of Graduate Affairs staff will reach out to you with detailed instructions and your options for completing Section 2, which includes presenting original documents from the list of acceptable documents.
Please direct any questions concerning Form I-9 to the Office of Graduate Affairs at graduateaffairs@brandeis.edu or visit us in Bernstein-Marcus (lower level).
Social Security Number (SSN) Information
International students must obtain a SSN as soon as possible after being hired. Instructions on this process can be found on the ISSO website. Please note that you can still complete your I-9 without a SSN. Once you have received your SSN, it can be added to your already submitted I-9 in Workday.
When are stipend checks issued?
Graduate students receive stipend checks twice a month. You will receive one half of your monthly stipend on the 15th of the month (or the closest workday before the 15th) and the other half on the last business day of the month. Your first payment will likely be a physical check delivered to your on-campus mailbox in your department. After you are activated in Workday, you can view your paychecks and set up a direct deposit for all future payments.
Direct Deposit
Forms are available through Workday to set up direct deposit for your stipend checks. If you require a paper copy of the direct deposit form please email payroll@brandeis.edu to request one.
Tax Treatment of Stipends
If you will be teaching or doing research this year, you will notice that income taxes will be withheld from some or all of your stipend. You must fill out a W-4 Form to ensure your tax withholdings are at a rate most appropriate to your individual circumstances. These forms are available on Workday, through the Payroll Office, or through the IRS. Please check the address listed in Workday to make sure it is up to date so your end of the year tax paperwork is delivered to the appropriate address.
You should also be aware that the remainder of your stipend may be subject to income taxation, although the University is not required to report it to the IRS or to withhold taxes from it. You should consult the relevant IRS guidance, tax preparation resources, or your tax advisor for the proper treatment in your particular situation, as Brandeis University cannot provide you with tax advice. If you are a non-U.S. citizen, your tax liability is dependent upon any treaties that exist between the U.S. and your country, among other factors. In order to claim a tax exemption, you must complete a Foreign Information Form, if you have not previously done so. This form will be made available to you in your Workday account. Once the form is completed and processed, you will be asked to meet with a Payroll supervisor to sign either a Form 8233 or a W-4 Form.
Please direct questions regarding tax forms or direct deposit to the Payroll Office at payroll@brandeis.edu or 781-736-4477. Questions about your appointment or the components of the stipend should be directed to the Office of Graduate Affairs at graduateaffairs@brandeis.edu.
